note: Keys and code stay English. name is the English verb. name_zh is a display gloss only. Clusters are assigned by hand. pass_through is an extension, not an RCC8 base relation. Critique verbs are schema only: not training targets until hand-labeled triples exist.

verbs.name: precedes
verbs.note: Peer time order inside one procedure. Does not set a layer and is not an experience-graph edge.

verbs.name: constitutes
verbs.note: Different kinds: matter constitutes an object. Not an array of the same element.

verbs.name: composes
verbs.note: Same kind of elements stacked into a collection, like a C array.

verbs.name: is part of
verbs.note: X is part of Y. Mereology, not peer affiliation.

verbs.name: is subordinate to
verbs.note: Affiliation between peers of the same kind. Not part_of.

verbs.name: constructs from
verbs.note: Critique of Pure Reason: build a structure from limited given information.

verbs.name: forbids
verbs.note: Critique of Practical Reason: what must not be done.

verbs.name: obliges
verbs.note: Critique of Practical Reason: what ought to be done.

verbs.name: aims at
verbs.note: Critique of Judgment: purposiveness, what is taken as the end. Not the moral law.
